blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.23
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.23

blocks.text: मध्येऽवरप्रसवः
blocks.directed: [slowly] मध्येऽवरप्रसवः

blocks.text: Madhye ’varaprasavaḥ.
blocks.directed: Madhye ’varaprasavaḥ.

blocks.text: In the middle, inferior manifestation arises.
blocks.directed: In the middle, inferior manifestation arises.

blocks.text: You Were Enlightened for Five Minutes, Then Your Brain Started Being a Dick Again.
blocks.directed: You Were Enlightened for Five Minutes, Then Your Brain Started Being a Dick Again.

blocks.text: Oh, this one hurts.
blocks.directed: Oh, this one hurts.

blocks.text: Because it’s absolutely devastatingly relatable.
blocks.directed: Because it’s absolutely devastatingly relatable.

blocks.text: We’ve just been through an extraordinary sequence.
blocks.directed: We’ve just been through an extraordinary sequence.

blocks.text: The yogi enters the Great Lake.
blocks.directed: The yogi enters the Great Lake.

blocks.text: The world is recognised as the expression of Śakti.
blocks.directed: The world is recognised as the expression of Śakti.

blocks.text: Innate knowledge becomes established.
blocks.directed: Innate knowledge becomes established.

blocks.text: Turya permeates waking, dreaming and deep sleep.
blocks.directed: Turya permeates waking, dreaming and deep sleep.

blocks.text: The outward movement of vital activity no longer obscures the conscious source.
blocks.directed: The outward movement of vital activity no longer obscures the conscious source.

blocks.text: Absolutely beautiful.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Absolutely beautiful.

blocks.text: And then Vasugupta says:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And then Vasugupta says:

blocks.text: In the middle, inferior manifestation arises.
blocks.directed: In the middle, inferior manifestation arises.

blocks.text: For God’s sake.
blocks.directed: For God’s sake.

blocks.text: WE WERE DOING SO WELL.
blocks.directed: WE WERE DOING SO WELL.

blocks.text: What happened?
blocks.directed: What happened?

blocks.text: Let’s unpack it.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack it.

blocks.text: Madhye — in the middle, in the intervening condition.
blocks.directed: Madhye — in the middle, in the intervening condition.

blocks.text: Avara — lower, inferior, lesser.
blocks.directed: Avara — lower, inferior, lesser.

blocks.text: Prasavaḥ — production, generation, arising.
blocks.directed: Prasavaḥ — production, generation, arising.

blocks.text: And here’s where Kṣemarāja becomes wonderfully precise.
blocks.directed: And here’s where Kṣemarāja becomes wonderfully precise.

blocks.text: He explains that the practitioner may experience the bliss of turya at the initial and final boundaries of the ordinary states.
blocks.directed: He explains that the practitioner may experience the bliss of turya at the initial and final boundaries of the ordinary states.

blocks.text: But may fail to maintain recognition throughout their middle portions.
blocks.directed: But may fail to maintain recognition throughout their middle portions.

blocks.text: And in that intervening condition, ordinary mental activity reasserts itself.
blocks.directed: And in that intervening condition, ordinary mental activity reasserts itself.

blocks.text: Vyutthāna.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Vyutthāna.

blocks.text: The state of ordinary mental emergence or activity, contrasted with spiritual absorption.
blocks.directed: The state of ordinary mental emergence or activity, contrasted with spiritual absorption.

blocks.text: This is not necessarily evil or immoral thought.
blocks.directed: This is not necessarily evil or immoral thought.

blocks.text: It’s the return of limited cognition, particularly when its differentiated contents are no longer recognised through their supreme source.
blocks.directed: It’s the return of limited cognition, particularly when its differentiated contents are no longer recognised through their supreme source.

blocks.text: Now think about how extraordinary this is.
blocks.directed: Now think about how extraordinary this is.

blocks.text: At the transition between states, the practitioner may recognise an opening.
blocks.directed: At the transition between states, the practitioner may recognise an opening.

blocks.text: Perhaps as a thought subsides.
blocks.directed: Perhaps as a thought subsides.

blocks.text: Perhaps at the emergence of waking.
blocks.directed: Perhaps at the emergence of waking.

blocks.text: Perhaps in a contemplative pause.
blocks.directed: Perhaps in a contemplative pause.

blocks.text: But then ordinary mental activity resumes.
blocks.directed: But then ordinary mental activity resumes.

blocks.text: And the mind becomes absorbed in its contents.
blocks.directed: And the mind becomes absorbed in its contents.

blocks.text: There’s the perception.
blocks.directed: There’s the perception.

blocks.text: Then the interpretation.
blocks.directed: Then the interpretation.

blocks.text: Then the appropriation.
blocks.directed: Then the appropriation.

blocks.text: Then the personal story.
blocks.directed: Then the personal story.

blocks.text: Then the emotional reaction.
blocks.directed: Then the emotional reaction.

blocks.text: And suddenly the universe has become a matter of what somebody said to you yesterday.
blocks.directed: And suddenly the universe has become a matter of what somebody said to you yesterday.

blocks.text: Śiva has been reduced from universal consciousness to a participant in a completely imaginary argument.
blocks.directed: Śiva has been reduced from universal consciousness to a participant in a completely imaginary argument.

blocks.text: Again.
blocks.directed: Again.

blocks.text: Now Kṣemarāja’s actual point is not simply that people become annoyed.
blocks.directed: Now Kṣemarāja’s actual point is not simply that people become annoyed.

blocks.text: That’s our modern illustration.
blocks.directed: That’s our modern illustration.

blocks.text: His concern is the interruption of the yogi’s continuous recognition of turya.
blocks.directed: His concern is the interruption of the yogi’s continuous recognition of turya.

blocks.text: The practitioner can apprehend the fourth state at privileged moments yet fail to sustain it throughout the entirety of experience.
blocks.directed: The practitioner can apprehend the fourth state at privileged moments yet fail to sustain it throughout the entirety of experience.

blocks.text: And this is why the word madhya is so important.
blocks.directed: And this is why the word madhya is so important.

blocks.text: The middle.
blocks.directed: The middle.

blocks.text: The interval.
blocks.directed: The interval.

blocks.text: The ordinary continuity of experience.
blocks.directed: The ordinary continuity of experience.

blocks.text: Not merely its beginnings and endings.
blocks.directed: Not merely its beginnings and endings.

blocks.text: Imagine listening to a symphony.
blocks.directed: Imagine listening to a symphony.

blocks.text: At the beginning, you become profoundly attentive.
blocks.directed: At the beginning, you become profoundly attentive.

blocks.text: The opening notes are extraordinary.
blocks.directed: The opening notes are extraordinary.

blocks.text: Then you start thinking about dinner.
blocks.directed: Then you start thinking about dinner.

blocks.text: Twenty minutes pass.
blocks.directed: Twenty minutes pass.

blocks.text: You become mentally involved in some unrelated matter.
blocks.directed: You become mentally involved in some unrelated matter.

blocks.text: Then the final movement begins.
blocks.directed: Then the final movement begins.

blocks.text: You suddenly return.
blocks.directed: You suddenly return.

blocks.text: And the ending is magnificent.
blocks.directed: And the ending is magnificent.

blocks.text: Now, you did indeed experience the opening and closing of the symphony.
blocks.directed: Now, you did indeed experience the opening and closing of the symphony.

blocks.text: But you missed much of the performance.
blocks.directed: But you missed much of the performance.

blocks.text: Something analogous is being described here.
blocks.directed: Something analogous is being described here.

blocks.text: Recognition at the boundaries does not necessarily imply uninterrupted recognition throughout the intervening states.
blocks.directed: Recognition at the boundaries does not necessarily imply uninterrupted recognition throughout the intervening states.

blocks.text: And now comes an important distinction.
blocks.directed: And now comes an important distinction.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja does not say that the practitioner is permanently lost.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja does not say that the practitioner is permanently lost.

blocks.text: The condition of limitation has reappeared, but the recognition already cultivated has not necessarily become entirely ineffective.
blocks.directed: The condition of limitation has reappeared, but the recognition already cultivated has not necessarily become entirely ineffective.

blocks.text: The possibility of returning remains.
blocks.directed: The possibility of returning remains.

blocks.text: He explicitly relates the phenomenon to Book II’s final sūtra, where the subsidence of pure knowledge produces dreamlike differentiated experience.
blocks.directed: He explicitly relates the phenomenon to Book II’s final sūtra, where the subsidence of pure knowledge produces dreamlike differentiated experience.

blocks.text: He also invokes the Mālinīvijayatantra to warn that the yogi can become diverted towards transient enjoyments and extraordinary attainments. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: He also invokes the Mālinīvijayatantra to warn that the yogi can become diverted towards transient enjoyments and extraordinary attainments. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And this is where the text becomes unusually psychologically acute.
blocks.directed: And this is where the text becomes unusually psychologically acute.

blocks.text: Because the mere memory of a profound experience is not identical to living within its recognition.
blocks.directed: Because the mere memory of a profound experience is not identical to living within its recognition.

blocks.text: You can remember what clarity felt like.
blocks.directed: You can remember what clarity felt like.

blocks.text: You can remember an extraordinary philosophical insight.
blocks.directed: You can remember an extraordinary philosophical insight.

blocks.text: You can even describe it with complete precision.
blocks.directed: You can even describe it with complete precision.

blocks.text: But at the present moment, you may be operating through precisely the limitations that the insight had disclosed.
blocks.directed: But at the present moment, you may be operating through precisely the limitations that the insight had disclosed.

blocks.text: And then the mind performs another trick.
blocks.directed: And then the mind performs another trick.

blocks.text: It begins chasing the previous recognition.
blocks.directed: It begins chasing the previous recognition.

blocks.text: “I need to get back.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I need to get back.”

blocks.text: “I’ve lost it.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I’ve lost it.”

blocks.text: “How do I recover the state?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “How do I recover the state?”

blocks.text: But the very structure of trying to obtain an experience can reinforce the sense of being a limited subject separated from something desirable.
blocks.directed: But the very structure of trying to obtain an experience can reinforce the sense of being a limited subject separated from something desirable.

blocks.text: It’s an exceptionally awkward situation.
blocks.directed: It’s an exceptionally awkward situation.

blocks.text: You’ve recognised the source.
blocks.directed: You’ve recognised the source.

blocks.text: Then forgotten.
blocks.directed: Then forgotten.

blocks.text: Then turned the memory of recognition into another object of attachment.
blocks.directed: Then turned the memory of recognition into another object of attachment.

blocks.text: Congratulations.
blocks.directed: Congratulations.

blocks.text: You’ve managed to become attached to freedom.
blocks.directed: You’ve managed to become attached to freedom.

blocks.text: A spectacular achievement.
blocks.directed: A spectacular achievement.

blocks.text: But Vasugupta doesn’t leave us here.
blocks.directed: But Vasugupta doesn’t leave us here.

blocks.text: Because the very next sūtra explains how recognition returns.
blocks.directed: Because the very next sūtra explains how recognition returns.

blocks.text: And this one is absolutely beautiful.
blocks.directed: And this one is absolutely beautiful.
